name: Morondava
description: On Madagascar's west coast, Morondava is the gateway to the Menabe region and to the famous Avenue of the Baobabs — a dirt road lined with centuries-old trees whose silhouettes at dusk have become one of Madagascar's defining images. The region is home to the Sakalava people and their distinct traditions. In film and photography, the landscapes of the Menabe — vast, dry, ancient — have come to represent a certain elemental Madagascar.
